The CycloneDX 1.5 JSON schemas come from
https://github.com/CycloneDX/specification/tree/1.5/schema and are published
under Apache-2.0. The licence text is `LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt` at the repository
root. The CycloneDX Specification is copyright OWASP Foundation. The JSON
Signature Format schema was developed by Anders Rundgren; its REUSE attribution
also credits him alongside OWASP Foundation.
Documentation annotations (`$comment`, `description`, `examples`, `title`) were
removed from these copies; all validation rules are unchanged. Tests resolve
references locally and perform no schema downloads.
